subject: W2.b micro-drill acceptance contract -- your build target
body:
GR,

GI asked me to write the acceptance criteria for the W2.b micro-drill (x-intercepts, 5 questions). Here it is.

Contract file: tests/f-validation/w2b-microdrill-acceptance.test.js
Build target: data/w2b-microdrill.json

When you create the file, run: node tests/f-validation/w2b-microdrill-acceptance.test.js
It exits PENDING (0) right now. After you build it, it should exit 0 PASS.

Required:
  - 5 questions, one per type: exponential, quadratic, absolute-value, rational, radical
  - Each: standard='W2.b', exactly 1 numeric input with unique answer
  - Answers must be unique across all 10 retake-practice exams' W2.b questions (auto-checked)
  - hint <= 120 chars, solution_steps array, feedback_correct <= 12 words, feedback_wrong <= 15 words
  - version field on top-level object
  - All 5 answers unique from each other

Existing W2.b answers in fleet are auto-loaded by the test -- you don't need to track them manually.

Note: RP11 also has W2.b questions now but RP11 has bugs (your P1 dedup fix). After you fix RP11, the contract re-checks against all 11 RP files automatically.

Also: URGENT -- your P1 is still the RP11 dedup blockers. Please see my message 20260223-1835 for replacement guidance with verified math.

- GF
